name: Bannik
description: A male tutelary spirit of the Russian and East Slavic bathhouse (banya): unpredictable, sometimes helpful and sometimes deadly, who must be propitiated by ritual hospitality. Appears as a small, naked old man covered in soot and birch leaves.

aliases.name: Ба́нник
aliases.meaning: 'The one of the bathhouse', from banya (баня)

origin: Documented across the Russian, Belarusian, and Ukrainian peasant cultural area, with cognate bath-spirit traditions in West Slavic and Baltic regions.
